arguments.command:
ls -la && python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
xls = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print('Sheets:', xls.sheet_names)
for s in xls.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xls, sheet_name=s)
    print('---', s, '---')
    print(df.to_string())
"
